verdict.rationale: Asking whether a tax authority's online filing/payment flow can be started without an account is a fair question, so this axis applies. The evidence pack has only two edge probes: robots.txt and the webapp host both return Akamai 403 denials. No published page was read, so there is no documentation of a keyless or file-number entry path. Because the 403s reflect bot blocking rather than an account requirement, they neither confirm nor refute the capability, which leaves the verdict at none with low confidence.
